import re
s=open('products/research/cantina-bounties-20261115.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
u=s.replace('\\"','"').replace('\\n',' ')
def ctx(k,a=300,b=900,n=2):
    seen=[]
    for m in re.finditer(k,u):
        c=u[max(0,m.start()-a):m.start()+b]
        if any(c[a:a+120]==x for x in seen): continue
        seen.append(c[a:a+120]); print('##',k,'>>',c,'\n')
        if len(seen)>=n: break
ctx('AI tooling is permitted',1500,1200,1)
ctx('For AI Agents and Automated Tools',200,2200,1)
ctx('submission fee',200,500,4)
ctx('[Dd]eposit',150,350,5)
for k in ['kycRequired','"joined"','depositAmount','submissionDeposit','"deposit']:
    print(k,[u[m.start():m.start()+60] for m in re.finditer(k,u)][:14])
for m in re.finditer(r'"name":"(Pendle[^"]*|Coinbase|Uniswap|Morpho)"',u):
